name: n8n hand-off - POST run output to an n8n webhook
description: Smallest useful VegaDuta -> n8n bridge: whatever this run's input is gets POSTed to an n8n Webhook trigger's production URL as a JSON object, and n8n's response (what its Respond to Webhook node answers, or the default acknowledgment) lands on the log channel as the run's output. Replace the REPLACE_ME in the url with your n8n webhook path before POSTing to /api/workflows. Two deployment facts to know before this fires: (1) the HTTP node's URL is validated by the platform's SSRF guard, which only allows public http(s) addresses - a private-IP or internal-DNS n8n is refused, so expose n8n on a public URL or behind a public reverse proxy; (2) if you add an Authorization header carrying a vault reference like 'Bearer {{secret.N8N_HEADER}}', that secret's own allowed-hosts list must include your n8n host or the reference never resolves. Body uses {{input_json}}: the upstream node's whole output embedded as one JSON string - rename 'input' to whatever the n8n workflow expects.

data.label: Manual trigger - input is handed to n8n
